name: Central AI Technology Group Limited
summary: Central AI Technology Group Limited engages in the green building photovoltaic integration business. It also engages in new energy and engineering, property management, smart logistics, food and beverage supply chain, and health and wellness business. The company was formerly known as Central New Energy Holding Group Limited and changed its name to Central AI Technology Group Limited in November 2026. Central AI Technology Group Limited was founded in 1996 and is based in North Point, Hong Kong. Central AI Technology Group Limited operates as a subsidiary of Central Culture Resource Group Limited.
